title: Parameter Mode
summary: Official Derivative reference for the four parameter modes: Constant, Expression, Export, and Bind, including UI color cues, export-mode availability, bind-mode synchronization, and Python access through the Par class.
guidance: Use this article when deciding whether a generated controller should write a constant, expression, export, or bind relationship.
Constant and expression modes can keep separate values, so toggling modes during debugging can reveal stale expression or constant state.
Export mode can only be selected when an export connection already exists; creating an export normally switches the parameter into export mode automatically.
Bind mode is for bidirectional synchronization and should not be treated like a one-way expression or CHOP export.
Python mode changes should use the Par class mode member rather than string-editing the parameter dialog state.
